comment: Config for the opencode terminal on the Master's admin surface. The terminal is the operator-facing half of the page Open WebUI serves at 10.100.0.1:8088 (relocated from 8080 on deployment, fabric Step 55); it has no listener of its own. The permission block below is the load-bearing part of Step 18: the surface may read and write the vault, and it may not reach a key. That is a structural claim, so it is worth encoding in the config a real session actually loads rather than only in the manifest a test reads.
